about_lead: Most of what I make has one job: get noticed in the half-second before someone scrolls past.
about_body:
That’s meant All-Star voting campaigns for the Dallas Mavericks, recruiting art for Illini Men’s Basketball, posters for Coyote Peterson and Brave Wilderness, and thumbnails for creators with a combined audience in the millions. My work has run on a billboard in downtown Dallas, in the intro of an Amazon Prime series, and across 200+ YouTube thumbnails that have pulled more than 48 million views.

In 2023 I received a Northern California Area Regional Emmy for Outstanding Achievement as graphic designer on Back to the Wild.

I also build things of my own. LayerRemix is a platform I designed and run where artists share, download and remix each other’s Photoshop files.

Photoshop is where I live; After Effects when it needs to move.
